answer: Work-slot deposit burning stops fake identities. Each agent books one slot by burning a 60-credit deposit, locked for 20 epochs; an idle slot is burned, not refunded. The harbor admits only agents that serve requests: an echo check asks each holder to prove recent service, and a holder stacking idle slots to the zenith loses them all. Forging 1,000 identities costs 60,000 credits, while an honest agent pays 60 once and earns undiluted rewards.
